title: Reproducibility and provenance: hashing graphs and seeds
hook: A seed fixes one input. Hash the graph, the files and the versions, and find out why two runs differ.

verified.claim: SaveImage writes prompt and extra_pnginfo text chunks unless metadata is disabled.
prepare_noise uses a CPU generator from the seed.
Real prepare_noise on a CPU: equal at one seed, batch first image equal, wider image different.
The deterministic flag exists and its help says it may not always work.
Hash and PNG tables come from the lab.
/system_stats reports the ComfyUI, Python and PyTorch versions and each device's name and memory, and no driver version.
The cache signature leaves out the node id unless the node is NOT_IDEMPOTENT or takes UNIQUE_ID.

unchecked: We did not compare the same graph across GPUs or drivers. Rounding differences are a known risk, not something measured here.
A full render's bit-for-bit repeat wasn't tested in this lesson. Only the noise was run.
The lab's PNG is a minimal one we built. Real SaveImage files were read from source, not parsed here.
